facts.business: Nova Iron and Steel Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of iron and steel products.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company proposes to enter into the trading business of metals and steel, subject to the approval of the Members.

The Company is in the process of transferring its assets to the lenders in compliance with the Award dated 24.11.2025, with a view to reducing its debt liabilities and supporting the long-term sustainability of the Company.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified Opinion: The company is not maintaining proper records showing full particulars, including quantitative details and situation of property, plant, and equipment. The property, plant and equipment have not been physically verified by the management at reasonable intervals. Title deeds of certain immovable properties (Land: Rs. 33.47 lakhs held by Mr. Sunil Gupta since 2012; Land: Rs. 160.87 lakhs held by Mr. R.K. Rastogi since 2012) are not in the name of the company. The schedule of repayment of principal and payment of interest for loans granted has not been stipulated.

key_risks: Volatility in raw material and consumable prices, particularly from China
Changes in statutory and sustainability norms in importing/exporting countries
Global trade tensions and tariff measures affecting supply chain reliability and export competitiveness
Volatile steel and raw material prices, global oversupply, changes in trade and tariff measures, and working capital and credit requirements for the proposed trading business
Ongoing transfer of assets to lenders and associated business challenges
Non-maintenance of proper records for property, plant, and equipment
Title deeds of certain immovable properties not in the name of the company
Loans granted without stipulated repayment terms
facts.related_party_note: Loans granted to other parties (aggregate amount granted during the year: Rs. 7.46 lakhs; balance outstanding: Rs. 119.96 lakhs). Aggregate amount of loan granted to promoters or other related parties: Nil. Title deeds of certain lands held in the name of Mr. Sunil Gupta and Mr. R.K. Rastogi (not promoters, directors, or their relatives/employees as per the report).
